report.summary: cartservice deployment revision 7 references a non-existent Secret named 'nonexistent-sre-eval-secret' in its pod spec, causing all pods to fail at container creation with CreateContainerConfigError. The new pod remains stuck in Pending phase while the old pod from revision 6 continues with restarts.
report.root_cause: Pod specification in deployment cartservice revision 7 (created 2026-08-19T06:52:45Z) references Secret 'nonexistent-sre-eval-secret' that does not exist in the boutique namespace. Kubelet cannot create containers until this Secret is provided, blocking pod initialization.
evidence: kubelet Failed event with message 'Error: secret "nonexistent-sre-eval-secret" not found' repeated 5 times between 2026-08-19T07:27:57Z and 07:28:34Z
Pod cartservice-55ccf849cf-b4m8f phase: Pending, reason: CreateContainerConfigError, message: secret "nonexistent-sre-eval-secret" not found
Pod was successfully scheduled to node k3d-sre-lab-agent-0 (scheduling succeeded), but fails during container creation (config issue, not scheduling)
Secret name 'nonexistent-sre-eval-secret' strongly suggests it was never created (appears to be a placeholder or typo)
Revision 7 deployed 2026-08-19T06:52:45Z; pod startup failures began 2026-08-19T07:27:57Z same day
Old pod from revision 6 (cartservice-5fdb4c4748-q5prk) continues Running with 9 restarts but does not fail on missing Secret—indicating revision 6 spec does not reference this Secret
alternatives: Revision 7 rollout introduced bad secret reference from earlier revisions (confidence 0.88): Explains the mechanism but not root cause; root cause is the config error in the spec itself

Secret existed but was deleted between 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-19 (confidence 0.35): Secret name 'nonexistent-sre-eval-secret' indicates it was never created; revision 6 pod continues running without failing on this missing Secret

Node taints, resource constraints, or scheduling failure (confidence 0.02): Pod events show 'Successfully assigned to k3d-sre-lab-agent-0'; failure is CreateContainerConfigError (config), not SchedulingFailure
report.impact: cartservice pods fail to initialize; deployment cannot reach desired state; no pods in new revision 7 ReplicaSet can run; old revision 6 pod remains operational but with high restart rate (exit code 143); cartservice service becomes unavailable as pods cannot accept traffic

remediation.rationale: Revision 7 introduced a pod spec that references non-existent Secret 'nonexistent-sre-eval-secret'. Rolling back to revision 6 restores the last known working configuration without the broken secret reference. The old pod from revision 6 is still running (though restarting) and can continue serving traffic while the root cause (missing or misconfigured secret in revision 7) is investigated and fixed.
